I2.1.2.2 The ship displacement DUI is the displacement, in kt, of the ship corresponding to the
            upper ice waterline (UIWL). Where multiple waterlines are used for determining the UIWL, the
            displacement is to be determined from the waterline corresponding to the greatest
            displacement.

development_coverage.scope: Select maximum displacement among represented waterline cases; not physical measurement or whole-waterline geometry.
unchecked: Finite nonnegative decimal inputs; not a proof of aggregation for arbitrary graphs, identity/multiple quantities or all numeric literal types.
No inference of fleet eligibility or physical UIWL measurements.
Only the listed synthetic graphs were tested; arbitrary multiplicities, datatypes and other unlisted branches are not certified.
development_coverage.provenance: Source/locked representation authored development inputs; never external evaluation fixtures, labels or counterfactuals.

acceptance_scope: Internal acceptance only; finite witnesses, static warnings and semantic review do not establish complete correctness.

persistent_failure_summary.instruction: Repeated observations remain failures despite query edits. Diagnose binding/branch structure from current evidence instead of cycling previous code. Unassessable means no evidence of resolution.
